name: Entrypoint Branch/PR Switch (static credentials)
description: Demonstrates pattern B from docs/extensions/lifecycle-hooks.md: {option.ref} wired directly into the entrypoint's own command line, resolved at container-create time - so branch/PR switching works from container start, with no dependency on launch.sh's timing. See mounts.bind below for how to add a statically-provisioned deploy key for a private repo.

options.name: ref
options.label: Branch or PR #
options.placeholder: e.g. main, feature/my-feature, or a PR number like 42

command:
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git sudo >/dev/null
REPO=/home/dockside/app
REF="$1"
# For a private repo: uncomment the mounts.bind entry above, then add:
#   export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i /home/dockside/.ssh/deploy_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"
# and use a git@... URL below instead of the https:// one.
[ -d "$REPO/.git" ] || git clone https://github.com/newsnowlabs/dockside.git "$REPO"
cd "$REPO"
# A ref that, once any leading '#' is stripped, is purely numeric (e.g. "42" or
# "#42") is a PR number; anything else is a branch name (same heuristic as
# checkout_git_ref() in app/scripts/container/launch.sh).
PR="" BRANCH="" NUM="${REF#'#'}"
case "$NUM" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) BRANCH="$REF" ;;
  *)           PR="$NUM" ;;
esac
if [ -n "$PR" ]; then
  # Two statements, not "git fetch ... && git checkout ...": under `set -e`, a
  # non-final command in an && list is exempt from aborting the script on
  # failure, so a bad PR number would otherwise fail silently and fall through.
  git fetch origin "refs/pull/$PR/head"
  git checkout FETCH_HEAD
elif [ -n "$BRANCH" ]; then
  git fetch origin "refs/heads/$BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$BRANCH"
  git switch "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || git switch --track -c "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH"
fi
sleep infinity
